text:
DIAMETER::retransmit
Description
This iRule command triggers the request in the retransmission queue
that is associated with the current answer message for retransmission.
This command will fail the current message is a request or if there is
not an associated request message in the retransmission queue.
Syntax
DIAMETER
::
retransmit
[
disabled
|
busy
|
unable
|
retransmit
]
[
NOTE
]
Examples
when
DIAMETER_EGRESS
{
if
{
[
DIAMETER
::
is_response
]
&&
!
[
DIAMETER
::
is_retransmission
]
}
{
log
local0.
"reason [DIAMETER::retransmission_reason]"
DIAMETER
::
retransmit
}
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
DIAMETER_EGRESS
